market_summary: Holiday edition — as of 08:25 IST on Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026. NSE/BSE equity cash and equity-derivatives markets are closed for Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev; regular trading resumes Wednesday, 25 Nov. Last Indian session (Mon 23 Nov): Nifty 50 closed at 25,349.65 (-1.75%) and Sensex at 82,435.99 (-1.77%). Fourteen of 16 major sectors fell; banks, private banks, financials and PSU lenders declined 2.4%–3.3%, metals fell 3.7%, mid-caps 1.0% and small-caps 0.7%. NSE-provisional cash flows showed FII/FPI net buying of ₹5,673 crore while DIIs net sold ₹2,760 crore. Overnight, US and Asian equities rebounded sharply after Nvidia surged 31.5%, but higher US Treasury yields and stronger Fed-hike pricing keep the cross-asset signal mixed. Brent was $89.50/bbl in Reuters' early-Tuesday snapshot. There is no Indian intraday session today; prepare for the next session on 25 Nov. I'm not a financial advisor; this is factual market context and scenario analysis, not personalized investment advice.

global_cues.title: NSE capital-market holiday: no equity session on 24 November
global_cues.detail: Verified schedule: NSE circular NSE/CMTR/71775 dated 12 Dec 2025 lists Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026 as a trading holiday for the capital-market segment on account of Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev. The next listed regular session is Wednesday, 25 Nov.
global_cues.source: National Stock Exchange of India, Circular NSE/CMTR/71775 (12 Dec 2025)

global_cues.title: BSE and NSE equity markets are closed today
global_cues.detail: Livemint reported at 06:40 IST on 24 Nov that both exchanges have suspended equity trading for Guru Nanak Jayanti; regular trading resumes Wednesday, 25 Nov. No Indian cash-market or equity-derivatives setup is actionable today.

global_cues.title: Wall Street and Asian equities rebound sharply on AI relief
global_cues.detail: Reuters reported at 06:59 IST on 24 Nov that the S&P 500 rose 4.7% and Nasdaq Composite 6.5% on Monday, while Nvidia gained 31.5%. In early Tuesday trade, MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan was up 4.6%, Japan's Nikkei 4.5%, South Korea's KOSPI 7.5% and Taiwan's Taiex 9.1%. Interpretation: the rebound improves the external risk tone for India's next session, but it follows a volatile AI-led selloff and is not a domestic-market opening signal today.

global_cues.title: Fed tightening expectations lift US yields and the dollar
global_cues.detail: Reuters reported at 06:59 IST on 24 Nov that futures markets had priced a December Fed rate increase as certain, versus 89% odds on Friday; the US 10-year Treasury yield was 4.94% and the 2-year 4.69%. Interpretation: higher US yields and a firmer dollar can offset some of the positive equity-risk impulse for emerging markets.

global_cues.title: Brent crude remains near a three-month low after a sharp fall
global_cues.detail: Reuters reported at 06:59 IST on 24 Nov that Brent was around $89.50/bbl early Tuesday after settling at $89.37/bbl on Monday, down 3.5%, as higher Middle East supply offset regional shipping and refinery risks. Interpretation: lower crude is relatively supportive for India's import bill, but the geopolitical supply-risk premium can return quickly.

global_cues.title: US October PCE inflation is due on Wednesday
global_cues.detail: Reuters' 23 Nov macro calendar lists October PCE and core PCE inflation for 25 Nov at 19:00 IST. The release is a key input into rate expectations ahead of the Federal Reserve's 9 Dec meeting; a material surprise could move yields, the dollar and global equity risk appetite.

swing.headline: Tata Steel announces linked APL Apollo stake purchase and downstream asset sale
swing.what_changed: Verified company disclosure (23 Nov; exact publication time not stated): Tata Steel agreed to acquire the 26.6% promoter stake in APL Apollo at ₹2,100 per share for ₹15,510 crore and make an open offer for a further 26% at ₹2,301.40 per share, valued at ₹16,756 crore. APL Apollo is to acquire Tata Steel's tubes business and Tata Steel's entire stake in Tata Steel Colors for a combined ₹28,000 crore. All transactions are subject to regulatory approvals; Tata Steel expects completion within FY2027.
swing.why_it_matters: Interpretation: the linked transactions materially reshape Tata Steel's downstream exposure and place the tubes/colour-coated businesses within APL Apollo. Asset-sale proceeds may offset the promoter-stake purchase, but the net cash, leverage and earnings effects depend on approvals, funding and completion; no synergy or earnings uplift is guaranteed.
swing.risk: Regulatory approvals, open-offer completion, asset-transfer conditions, acquisition financing and integration remain unresolved. The announced terms are not a live price or a guaranteed catalyst.
swing.source: Tata Steel official press release, 23 Nov 2026 (time not stated)

swing.headline: Funding and execution risk dominate APL Apollo's proposed acquisition of Tata Steel assets
swing.what_changed: Verified: APL Apollo is to acquire Tata Steel's tubes business and its entire stake in Tata Steel Colors for ₹28,000 crore. Tata Steel's 23 Nov release says APL Apollo plans to use acquisition financing initially and subsequently replace that debt with long-term capitalisation. Reuters reported APL Apollo shares fell 21.3% on 23 Nov and cited analyst concerns about funding the acquisition.
swing.why_it_matters: Interpretation: the assets could expand capacity and product mix, but near-term leverage, financing terms and the ability to refinance are the key swing variables. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and has not closed.
swing.risk: Acquisition debt, refinancing, regulatory approvals, open-offer mechanics and execution risk; the reported 23 Nov share-price move is historical, not a live quote.
swing.source: Reuters, 23 Nov 2026; Tata Steel official release, 23 Nov 2026

swing.headline: HDFC Bank fell with broad financial-sector profit-taking on 23 November
swing.what_changed: Reuters reported HDFC Bank lost 3.3% on Monday as banks, private banks, financials and PSU lenders declined 2.4%–3.3% after rising 18%–22.5% over the prior four weeks. Reuters attributed the broad market pullback to profit-taking, positioning ahead of weekly derivatives expiry and the Tuesday market holiday; the report did not identify an HDFC Bank-specific catalyst.
swing.why_it_matters: Interpretation: the decline is best treated as sector and market-tape weakness rather than evidence of a new company-specific impairment. Banking-sector breadth and price stabilisation are the relevant checks when trading resumes on 25 Nov.
swing.risk: No company-specific trigger was identified in the cited report; sector weakness may reverse after the global risk rebound. The 3.3% move is a 23 Nov historical observation, not a live quote.

investing.headline: Scheduled addition to the BSE Sensex effective 21 December 2026
investing.what_changed: Verified BSE Index Services reconstitution release dated 20 Nov 2026 lists Shriram Finance as an addition to the BSE Sensex, effective at the open on Monday, 21 Dec 2026. The release does not state a publication time.
investing.why_it_matters: Interpretation: Sensex-tracking funds may need to add exposure around the rebalance, potentially affecting flows and liquidity. Index inclusion is a benchmark event, not a change in the company's operating fundamentals.
investing.risk: Passive-flow size and timing are uncertain; the announcement may already be reflected in the price and does not guarantee outperformance.
investing.source: BSE Index Services, official reconstitution release, 20 Nov 2026 (time not stated)

investing.headline: Scheduled removal from the BSE Sensex effective 21 December 2026
investing.what_changed: Verified BSE Index Services reconstitution release dated 20 Nov 2026 lists Trent as a deletion from the BSE Sensex, effective at the open on Monday, 21 Dec 2026. The release does not state a publication time.
investing.why_it_matters: Interpretation: Sensex-tracking funds may reduce exposure around the rebalance, which can affect near-term flows. Index deletion alone does not establish deterioration in Trent's operating fundamentals.
investing.risk: Passive-flow effects are uncertain and may already be priced in; this is not a fundamental earnings signal or a guaranteed price direction.
investing.source: BSE Index Services, official reconstitution release, 20 Nov 2026 (time not stated)
